title: Lepidopter in Second Life
content: ASecond Lifeuser named Bunnys Fride visiting theJules Verne Museumin Nantes, France saw my painting of the "lepidopter" flying machine and asked if he could create it for Second Life. It's nowavailable for freefrom the marketplace there.(Video Link) Natascha made this video of the contraption in action.Thanks, Bunnys Fride.Lepidopter, free from the Second Life MarketplacePreviously on GurneyJourney:Painting the LepidopterUnveiling at the Jules Verne Museum
